title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
benefit: Merit-based support for eligible undergraduate and postgraduate students.
eligibilitySummary: College or university students meeting the income and academic criteria.

title: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: Support towards tuition and living expenses at notified institutions.
eligibilitySummary: SC students admitted to eligible higher-education institutions.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minority Students
benefit: Financial assistance for eligible students pursuing post-matric education.
eligibilitySummary: Students from notified minority communities in class 11 and above.

title: Jagananna Vidya Deevena
department: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefit: Higher-education fee reimbursement for eligible students.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible Andhra Pradesh students in approved higher-education courses.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme
department: All India Council for Technical Education
benefit: Support for eligible women students in technical education.
eligibilitySummary: Women enrolled in eligible AICTE-approved technical programmes.

title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme
department: All India Council for Technical Education
benefit: Technical-education support for students with disabilities.
eligibilitySummary: Students with disabilities in eligible AICTE-approved programmes.

title: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit Scheme
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit: Collateral-free working-capital loan pathway for street vendors.
eligibilitySummary: Street vendors who meet the programme's local verification requirements.

title: NITI Aayog Internship Programme
benefit: Policy and programme research internship opportunity, subject to the current call for applications.
eligibilitySummary: Students and recent graduates meeting the current programme requirements.

title: Digital India / MeitY Internship Opportunities
department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
benefit: Technology and digital-governance internship opportunities when calls are open.
eligibilitySummary: Eligible students and graduates in relevant technology disciplines.

title: Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship
benefit: Education support opportunity, subject to the current application cycle.
eligibilitySummary: Students meeting the current academic and household-income criteria.

title: Foundation Scholarship Opportunities
benefit: Curated scholarship opportunities from partner foundations.
eligibilitySummary: Eligibility varies by partner; verify the current application notice before applying.

title: Private Technology Internship Opportunities
benefit: Shortlisted technology internship opportunities from participating employers.
eligibilitySummary: Students or graduates with relevant technical skills; openings vary by employer.
